description: Animated English military-history video production with Squire's code-drawn 2D vector engine, historically grounded characters, horses, armies, parchment maps, tactical diagrams, procedural music/SFX, thumbnails, and a GitHub Actions production lane for Nolane-x/video using VoiceStudio narration.

interface.longDescription: H2 Squire Studio creates long-form and short animated military-history videos using code-drawn 2D vector animation. It includes historical storytelling, the Squire engine, period character/horse/army packs, parchment maps, tactical diagrams, procedural music and sound effects, voice preparation, thumbnails and production QA. In Nolane-x/video, use the public source integration and GitHub Actions workflow for automated VoiceStudio narration and cloud rendering.
interface.shortDescription: Animated military-history video production with Squire vector animation, procedural audio and GitHub Actions rendering.

name: h2-squire-studio
